errors.evidence: The years on the x-axis are arranged in chronological order (2014, 2015, 2016, etc.), not alphabetical order.
The bars for each year are grouped side-by-side (horizontally), not stacked or grouped vertically.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по азбучен ред по хоризонталната ос.

errors.text_span: а за „от тях реколтириани“ са около 30000 хектара
errors.evidence: The description states the highest values for harvested areas are around 30,000 hectares, but the chart clearly shows a peak value in 2015 of approximately 36,000 hectares. This significantly understates the peak.

errors.text_span: като във всички години тези стойности са почти постоянни, с леко намаление в последните години
errors.evidence: This statement is inaccurate for the harvested areas (orange bars). Their values are not 'почти постоянни' (almost constant); they show a significant decrease from a peak of about 36,000 in 2015 to about 26,000 in 2022.
